prompt:
Load the people data from `peeps.csv` using Polars, then create a Great Tables table that:
- shows only the people who live in Canada (country is "CAN")
- combines name_given and name_family into a single "Name" column
- combines city and state_prov into a single "Location" column, as "City, Province"
- makes each email address a clickable link
- shows gender as an icon of a woman or a man instead of as text
- sorts by family name
- adds a title "Canadian Contacts"

The CSV has columns: name_given, name_family, address, city, state_prov, postcode, country, email_addr, phone_number, country_code, gender, dob, height_cm, weight_kg
